name: onmhj
description: Local AI-session worklog capture with language-aware reports and git-backed sync.

interface.longDescription: Captures Codex hook events to local JSONL, then flushes device-tagged daily raw and language-aware markdown logs to a user-registered git repository. Flush pulls and merges existing raw logs before committing. Daily report generation defaults to active Codex/Claude Code auth; API mode is reserved for explicit bulk backfills.
